capabilities: sync configured journal folders to Pensio automatically on change or on a 5-minute interval
map entry type, date, and title from YAML frontmatter
sync a People folder as Pensio relationship profiles with aliases
show live sync status and failures in the status bar
run manual sync, force-sync, and disconnect commands from the command palette
disambiguation: Not cross-device vault sync; it only uploads configured journal folders to the Pensio web service for processing.
extras: README discloses that journal content is sent to pensio.app servers over HTTPS for storage and AI analysis, with a linked privacy policy; notes over ~2 MB are not synced; beta builds installable via BRAT; works on Obsidian mobile; manual token entry and self-hosting under Advanced settings.
intentEvidence: This plugin connects your Obsidian vault to Pensio so you can keep writing in your favorite editor while Pensio adds the intelligence layer on top.
problem: Obsidian keeps journal notes as plain local files with no built-in analysis, so getting emotion tracking, patterns, or relationship insights requires leaving the vault.

relations.evidence: This plugin connects your Obsidian vault to Pensio so you can keep writing in your favorite editor

summary: Syncs journal folders from a vault to the Pensio web service, which applies AI emotion analysis, weekly insights, and relationship mapping.
